title: Technical Solution Architect Experience
experienceRequired: 10+ years of experience in software development, including at least 8 years in a solution architecture role.
jobDescription:
Position: Technical Solution Architect Experience: 10+ years Location: Hyderabad Employment Type: Full-Time About the Role We are seeking a seasoned Technical Solution Architect with extensive experience in product development to drive end-to-end solution design, architecture strategy, and product innovation. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader, with the ability to align technical solutions with […] Key Responsibilities Solution Architecture s Design Design and implement scalable, robust, and high-performing solutions for complex systems and applications. Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications and architecture. Provide technical leadership for product development teams and ensure adherence to architectural best practices.
2. Product Development Leadership Oversee the technical roadmap, ensuring alignment with product vision and market trends. Contribute to the full product lifecycle, from conceptualization to delivery, using agile and Dev Ops practices. Evaluate and recommend frameworks, tools, and technologies for product innovation. Technical Expertise Drive architecture decisions in areas like microservices, cloud computing, distributed systems, and API development. Ensure solutions adhere to performance, security, and compliance standards. Conduct technical risk assessments and propose mitigation strategies.
4. Collaboration and Mentorship Work closely with cross-functional teams including product management, engineering, and QA to deliver seamless solutions. Mentor engineering teams to develop expertise in architecture principles, coding standards, and best practices.
5. Innovation and Continuous Improvement Stay updated with emerging technologies and evaluate their potential for product and business improvement. Introduce architectural improvements and technical innovation to stay ahead in a competitive market. Required Skills and Qualifications Experience: 10+ years of experience in software development, including at least 8 years in a solution architecture role. Proven track record in designing and implementing enterprise-grade products and platforms. · Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in programming languages like Java, Python, .NET. In-depth knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (Kubernetes, Docker). Expertise in architectural patterns (Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Serverless). Strong understanding of Dev Ops, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Ia C). Hands-on experience with database design (SQL/No SQL) and distributed systems. Soft Skills: Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. RESPONSIBILITIES:
The UI Data Analyst will be responsible for collecting, analysing, and visualizing data to improve the user experience of our products / dashboards that supports both existing dashboard development needs and overall UI improvements. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of data analysis and visualization, as well as experience with user experience design.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
– Collect and analyse data to identify trends and patterns that can be used to improve the user experience of our products / dashboards. – Visualize data to create clear and concise reports that can be easily understood by the 3PDC (Third Party Data Center) Leadership team and other stakeholders. – Work with 3PDC analytics manager to implement changes based on the data analysis and visualization findings. – Stay up to date on the latest data analysis and visualization tools and techniques. Preparation of various project documentation (User Guide/Developer Guides/Unit Testing validation documents.) Have a great zeal to learn and right attitude to implement.
